title: App Permissions
drDigitalIntro:
Apps ask for permissions when they need access to something on your device.
• Common permissions: Camera, Microphone, Location.
• Ask yourself: does this app actually need this?
• A puzzle game asking for your camera is suspicious — a photo-sharing app is not.
• You can always say no. You can change permissions later in Settings.

playgroundTask.goal: You evaluated and responded to app permission requests

steps.say: Click on Puzzle Quest to see its details.
Click Install. It asks for Camera access — a puzzle game has no reason to need that!
Click Don't Allow — this permission is suspicious for a puzzle game.
Good. Now search for 'PhotoFun' — a photo-sharing app that genuinely needs your camera.
PhotoFun needs Camera access to take and share photos — that makes sense. Click Allow.

drDigitalSuccess: You evaluated permissions like a pro! Always ask: does this app actually need what it is asking for?
drDigitalHint: Read what each app is asking for. Deny anything that does not make sense for what the app does.
